character: A lean woman, about twenty-eight, short-cropped hair. Very still, face blank and watchful.
wardrobe: Close-fitting dark sailor's clothes, soft dark deck boots, two daggers worn crosswise at the small of her back.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's deck, a dagger in each hand, weight on the balls of her feet.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Dropping onto a ship's bow from a swinging rope, daggers drawn, sea spray behind her.
